english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when singing or playing sounds musically poor or unpleasant.

examples.english: I sing unmusically, and even the neighbour’s dog walks away.
examples.traditional: 我唱歌唱得唔好聽，連隔籬屋隻狗都走開。
